name: Himemiya-san wa Kamaitai
original_name: 姫宮さんはかまいたい
source:
The protagonist quit his club a few days ago. While wandering around the school's club building looking for a club to join, he happened to be in the tea ceremony club's room by chance.

There he met a senpai, Himemiya Tsubaki, who forcefully recruited him into the club.

In the tea ceremony club full of ghost members, a love story that starts with a club activity for just the two of them begins.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://prekano.com/products/himemiya/#story]Official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公几天前退出了原来的社团。他在学校的社团楼里闲逛，想找个新社团加入，却偶然走进了茶道部的活动室。

在那里，他遇见了学姐姬宫椿，并被她强行拉进了茶道部。

茶道部里尽是挂名不来的人，一段始于两个人社团活动的恋爱故事，就此展开。

[译写自[url=http://prekano.com/products/himemiya/#story]官方网站[/url]]
